description: Tempo 30-Zonen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Dieser Datensatz enthält Informationen zu den Tempo 30-Zonen in der Stadt Köln. Er zeigt alle derzeitig umgesetzten Zonen. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are bauen-und-wohnen, geo, infrastruktur. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
